name: Choose the primary contact by person id
title: SC-12-06-03 Choose the primary contact by person id
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit has an active owner on record
When the manager chooses that owner as the primary contact
Then the contact request carries the owner's person id

testSteps.description: [flutter-test] flutter/test/responsible_contact_selection_test.dart::choosing a contact sends the person card id
